title: Ptolemy 2

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Well hello! I had a feeling we'd meet again. Like what you read in the Ana-Blog I assume?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well hello! I had a feeling we'd meet again. Like what you read in the Ana-Blog I assume?

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Yeah cool. Cool cool. Same. Would you like to take a look at the next edition?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah cool. Cool cool. Same. Would you like to take a look at the next edition?

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: It did, didn't it! I have another if you'd like to give it a go?

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Well... that is good to know! Hey I have written another Ana-Blog if you want to read it?

nodes.text: It didn't make a lot of sense to me.

nodes.text: It had some really captivating ideas.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: It had some really captivating ideas.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Well you can't please everyone... was it the writing style you didn't like? Doesn't matter really.... but was it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well you can't please everyone... was it the writing style you didn't like? Doesn't matter really.... but was it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just don't like the idea of purging all my tech.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was quite sexual.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm kidding I loved it.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Oh you spotted that? Were you... into it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh you spotted that? Were you... into it?

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Well I can only take you by the hand. I cannot make you drink the drink.... that said. I do have a copy of this weeks Ana-Blog if you'd like to take a peek?
